snippet.title: Crystal Anomaly no commentary 1064 score
snippet.description:
Today I watched someone play my game and immediately bounce. Since it's not an accessible game at all I don't mind, but it gave me the idea of recording a full playthrough so players can decide whether it seems interesting to them before they sink their time into it.

1064 is a decent score for not having played in a while but I can tell that I've gotten rusty (:
